name: known-gap-domain-enum-loses-industry
reason: HALF CLOSED by #53. 'logistics' now matches: prefFieldsFor's domain branch reads screening_summary.industry alongside signals.Domain, and the industry here is 'freight logistics visibility platform'. jd_extraction.tmpl still constrains `domain` to a closed enum with no logistics or freight value, so the enum alone still says 'saas' -- the fix was widening the fields, not the enum. What remains is 'supply chain' (weight 8, the persona's second-strongest positive), which appears in neither the industry string nor core_competencies on this fixture. containsPhrase requires a contiguous whole-word run, and nothing in these signals contains that phrase, so the row is still reported as an unmet gap on the JD it describes best. Closing it needs either a vocabulary layer for preference labels (the aliases mechanism tags already have) or richer extraction -- not more routing.
description: Asserted separately from strong-match.json so the enforced case can hold a real preference floor while the remaining half of this gap stays visible.
